skill.name: artifacts-builder
skill.description: Create complex Claude artifact projects with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui, then bundle them into single HTML files.
skill.summary: Scaffold and bundle advanced React-based Claude artifacts.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are benign Markdown formatting, type comments, schema URLs, or expected scaffolding file edits. The real risks are the community shell scripts, local project file modifications, and npm supply-chain exposure from installing many packages during setup and bundling.

remediation.issue: Shell scripts install dependencies and modify project files automatically.
remediation.suggestion: Document every command, require user confirmation before global installs, and provide a dry-run mode for generated file changes.

remediation.issue: Several npm packages are installed without pinned immutable versions.
remediation.suggestion: Pin package versions, include a lockfile template, and recommend installing with scripts disabled when practical.

remediation.issue: The component archive is shipped as a binary tarball.
remediation.suggestion: Publish the component files as normal source files or include a checksum and manifest for the archive.

content.value_statement: Complex Claude artifacts need more structure than a single HTML file. This skill scaffolds a React, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui project and bundles it for sharing.
actual_capabilities: Creates a React 18 and TypeScript Vite project from a shell script.
Configures Tailwind CSS 3.4.1 with shadcn/ui theme variables.
Adds path aliases for imports from the generated src directory.
Installs Radix UI and related shadcn/ui dependencies.
Extracts bundled shadcn/ui component source files into the project.
Bundles the project into one self-contained HTML file with Parcel and html-inline.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or newer and a working npm or pnpm environment.
Runs shell scripts that install packages and modify local files.
Targets browser-based Claude artifacts, not backend services or native apps.
The bundled output may need manual testing for complex interactions.

best_practices: Run the initialization script in a clean workspace and review generated files before editing them.
Keep artifact state and UI components small enough to inspect before bundling.
Test the bundled HTML in a browser before sharing important artifacts.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for simple static HTML that does not need React or build tooling.
Do not run the scripts in a directory that contains unrelated production files.
Do not publish bundled output before checking package install results and browser behavior.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui project for advanced Claude artifacts.

faq.question: Does it produce one shareable file?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundle script builds the project and creates a single bundle.html file with assets inlined.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it require package installation?
faq.answer: Yes. The scripts use npm and pnpm to install frontend and bundling dependencies.

faq.question: Is this best for simple artifacts?
faq.answer: No. It is intended for complex artifacts that need React, state management, routing, or reusable components.

faq.question: What should I review before running it?
faq.answer: Review the shell scripts, package install commands, generated file changes, and the bundled component archive.
